how: The suggestions record, written by tools/suggest_ledger.js in the job and held by tools/suggest_check.js. night (since 7 November 2026, the owner's call): each night's one set on the Suggested Parlays tab, across every game of the night (the first Eastern date with a game to tip, never preseason), its team legs alone (moneyline, spread, total, at DraftKings' prices in lines.json and the builder's chance, 45% to 97%, none far off DraftKings, no value bar), one side and one total a game: Safe the likeliest 2-leg parlay, Medium the likeliest of 2 to 5 legs paying $4 or more on $1, Aggressive the likeliest of 2 to 5 paying $8 or more, by the builder's own sums; keyed season|date|first tip|<season>_<date>_NIGHT, its pool kept beside it (each leg's key, price and chance, each game's two legs' joint chance and price) so the check works every level out again, rewritten while the night's lock (2 hours before its first tip-off) is to come and locked from it (held so though its first tip-off moves later; no set is taken of a night DraftKings has posted no line for), graded leg by leg as its games finish. night_summary: per level, as below, from the night map alone. featured (until 7 November 2026): each game on national TV's three parlays on the Suggested Parlays tab (Safe, Medium, Aggressive, 2 to 4 legs from that game alone, every bet type; a player's chance is the props model's, on trial; a set taken by the page that drew four, before 2026-11-05T03:00:00Z or by a run of it that landed after, holds a fourth, Extreme, 5 legs, kept and graded as it was), taken from the published page on the state just published and DraftKings' lines in lines.json, keyed season|date|tip|game, rewritten while the set's lock (2 hours before tip-off) is to come and locked from it, so each entry is the set as the job last published it before the lock; from the lock to tip-off a level holding a player the injury report has since listed is built again, that level alone, and recorded in updates. From tip-off it is graded as a book settles it, by the page's own settlement (the scores, and each player's box line: a player with none did not play, void): a leg lost loses; a push or void leg drops out and the rest are paid at the builder's price on the legs left; every leg a push or void is a push, the stake back; the payout on a $1 stake. featured_summary: per level, the parlays graded won or lost (each season's game and level once), won, the wins expected by DraftKings' fair chance and by the model's, and units on $1, Extreme's from the sets that hold it (taken by the page that drew four: before 2026-11-05T03:00:00Z, or by a run of it that landed after), kept as history. Never edited by hand: the check refuses a ledger whose locked entries moved.
